package.name: x30_bridge
package.description: The handheld's UDP gateway to the X30 (teleop protocol v1 of Pashupati, with the X30's own commands and state): the stick as an operator source of the control mux, the commands of the stack (mode, e-stop, routes, patrol, docking, the robot's postures and gaits, the camera recorder, an inspection), the robot's state, JPEG frames of the inspection camera and a downsampled cloud. No ROS on the handheld.
